mentions.name: Personal printmaking practice (linocut and beyond)
mentions.description: A personal printmaking practice in which the author sketches to support their main passion of printmaking, primarily working in linocut (carving negative space into linoleum, inking it up, and printing on paper), with a membership at a local atelier and recent expansion into drypoint, kitchen lithography, and LEGOpress.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been learning how to sketch which supports my bigger passion- printmaking. I’ve primarily been doing linocut which is carving negative space into linoleum, inking it up, and printing it on paper. I’ve got a membership at a local atelier and have branched out into drypoint, kitchen lithography, and what I guess is called LEGOpress.
